text:
incident-bot: Pager: kv-cache perf alert (p95/p99 tokens) in us-west-2. Rate of continuous-batch hits spiking, cache size growing rapidly, abnormal paging to host. Investigating.

sre_oncall_anna: seeing big increase in writeback and paging I/O on GPU nodes, several hosts >80% kv-cache mem and IO saturation. Latency p99 tokens jumped from 120ms -> 1.4s for some routes.

eng_runtime_jon: thanks, Anna. Any correlation with recent rollout? Release-bot, did we flip any speculative decoding flags last 10m?

release-bot: Deployment event: disabled model_prefetch_coalescing for speculative-decoder v2 at 2156788820 by eng_runtime_jon. No rollout to prod autoscale groups (canary only).

eng_ml_maria: we did a config tweak for speculative decoding to improve throughput on long-form generation; it should have been canary. Might be interacting badly with continuous batching prefetch.

support_carol: Customer-facing impact: two enterprise customers reported 5xxs from chat/assistant flows and a high rate of partial responses. Others saw autocomplete delays. Not widespread but hitting key accounts.

eng_runtime_jon: hypothesis: speculative decoder's draft/target sync is creating a feedback loop with our prefix prefetch + continuous batching, producing many small pseudo-writes to KV cache and duplicating drafts -> cache blowup -> paging -> bursting latency.

eng_ml_maria: yes, if speculative decoder creates transient draft keys that are different from target keys we see cache divergence and heavy eviction churn. That can cause extra reads/writes as batching tries to reconcile.

eng_runtime_jon: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable speculative decoding on canary/prod; 2) reduce continuous_batch_size to 1 for affected model-routes; 3) throttle prefetch path TTL to avoid creating drafts. Which is fastest?

sre_oncall_anna: fastest is config toggle to disable speculative decoding globally for that model group. I can push a hot-config change. Lowering batch size needs rolling cfg across inference nodes (slower).

devx_ryan: to be safe, we can do this: flip speculative decoding off for spec-models in us-west-2 and simultaneously set kv-cache-prefetch-ttl=250ms to avoid draft keys being cached for long. I can apply both; risk is lower throughput for those routes.

eng_ml_maria: agree, lower perf but should stop the spiral. Also capture a prompt sample set to reproduce.

sre_oncall_anna: performing hot-config now: PATCH /ops/configs/speculative-decoding -> enabled=false for tag:speculative-v2 region:us-west-2. Rolling change across 12 nodes.

incident-bot: Change set started by sre_oncall_anna at 2156789235. Monitoring.
more_text:
sre_oncall_anna: Change applied to 6/12 nodes, avg p99 token latency dropped to 480ms on those nodes. Paging I/O decreased on those hosts.

eng_runtime_jon: good sign. Starting a targeted kv-cache eviction hold to stabilize working set: setting eviction.disabled=true for the group for 60s.

support_carol: customers updated: sent interim note to impacted customers "We're seeing reduced latency and are applying mitigations; will follow up with RCA."

eng_ml_maria: capturing logs and traces for draft/target key namespace to produce repro. Please keep config snapshots.

sre_oncall_anna: rolling to remaining nodes. After all 12 nodes, cluster p99 token latency is 220ms (down from 1.4s). Paging I/O back to baseline.

devx_ryan: applied kv-cache-prefetch-ttl=250ms. Also patched a short-term change to coalesce draft keys by normalizing draft suffix. Deploy ID: deploy-2156789402.

release-bot: Deploy deploy-2156789402 started by devx_ryan at 2156789402; completed on prod groups at 2156789467.

eng_runtime_jon: next steps: 1) leave speculative decoding disabled for 2 hours while we collect traces 2) run controlled canary with normalized-draft-key behavior and watch for cache churn 3) plan a code fix to avoid generating duplicate transient keys for speculative path.

sre_oncall_anna: agreed. For now we mark severity: Sev3 -> customer impact limited to a handful of customers, mitigation successful. Will keep monitoring and escalate if new errors.

support_carol: will follow up with customers in 30m with status update.

eng_ml_maria: I'll own the follow-up patch for speculative decoder key normalization. ETA 2 days for PR + bench.

eng_runtime_jon: handing off to next oncall. @sre_oncall_lei you're up in 15. Summary: prefetched drafts + continuous batching caused cache divergence and eviction/paging spiral; speculative decoding disabled and prefetch TTL reduced; deploy to normalize draft keys applied. Cluster stable; monitor p95/p99 and eviction rate.

sre_oncall_lei: acknowledged. I'll keep watch for 2h and confirm no regression.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident thread closed for active paging at 2156789678.
